title: いちょうと秋の木の葉
subject_en: Autumn ginkgo and fallen-leaf illustrations, each ONE separate object or small scene centred in its cell, golden yellow and warm orange with dark brown outlines, flat style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: いちょうの葉や並木道、ぎんなん、落ち葉遊びを描いた秋の素材です。季節のお知らせや挿し絵に使えます。
